description: "The Boy Travellers in South America" by Thomas Wallace Knox is a travel narrative written in the late 19th century. The book describes the adventures of two youths, Frank Bassett and Fred Bronson, as they journey through various countries in South America, including Ecuador, Peru, Bolivia, Brazil, and Argentina, while exploring the rich landscapes and cultures of the continent.
